name: Wait for Sirra to Finish
summary: In Darkshire's Town Hall, Sirra Von'Indi deciphers Abercrombie's cryptic note. As the resident scholar puts quill to paper, dread settles over the room, and the hermit's words hint at danger.

sections.title: A Moment of Translation
sections.body: Sirra Von'Indi has the note Abercrombie sent from his seclusion. The scholar aids the Night Watch and Darkshire's leaders, and needs only a short time to decipher the message. He does not yet know what horrors its words conceal.

sections.title: An Ominous Chill
sections.body: When Sirra finishes the transcription, a sudden heaviness fills the room, like a black curtain falling over the region. The note warns of great danger for Darkshire. Abercrombie's seemingly harmless errands were part of a sinister, vengeful design.

faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi is a scholar who lives in Darkshire's Town Hall. He helps Mayor Ello Ebonlocke and the local authorities translate ancient scripts, strange documents, and ciphered messages brought in from Duskwood's gloomy wilds.
The note was written by Abercrombie, the hermit living in a shack near Duskwood's western edge. You carried out a string of errands for him before the note came to Sirra for translation.

faq.q: Why does the air feel heavy when he finishes?
faq.answer: The heaviness is an omen of impending doom. The note brings grim news for Darkshire, and its full meaning becomes clear when the translation reaches Lord Ello Ebonlocke.

faq.q: Who should receive the translated letter next?
aliases: where do i take the translation
faq.answer: When Sirra finishes translating, he asks you to carry the chilling words across the room to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, so the Night Watch can prepare for what is coming.

faq.q: Is Abercrombie actually an enemy of Darkshire?
faq.answer: Abercrombie presents himself as a harmless, reclusive old man who needs help to survive. The dread that falls as Sirra finishes suggests grim news for Darkshire, and the note's full meaning becomes clear when it reaches Lord Ello Ebonlocke.

faq.q: Why do you have to wait for him?
faq.answer: Sirra needs time and focus to translate ancient ciphers. He parses the hermit's handwriting and coded phrasing before producing a readable transcript for the mayor.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you know Darkshire's fragile safety hangs by a thread.
As a mage, you recognize the dark, lingering resonance of a cursed message as its contents are laid bare.
